# SpikeCodedFeatureAssociation

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method for associating object identities across frames using spike-timing-dependent plasticity or temporal spike patterns rather than traditional floating-point feature vectors. Supports in-network neuromorphic associative memory, reducing data movement and latency in distributed tracking systems.
